newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA LEV CLOSES FLAT AFTER DULL TRADE.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA LEV CLOSES FLAT AFTER DULL TRADE.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed early at
1,500-1,502 per dollar on Saturday, flat from the opening's
1,499-1,502 as interbank trade was confined to low volumes and
was almost non-existent in the afternoon, dealers said.
"Small foreign currency volumes changed hands near 1,500
levs per dollar today. Banks were mainly servicing a limited
number of final clients with their own funds," a commercial
The local market was open on Saturday following a long
holiday for Eastern Orthodox Easter and Labour Day last week.
